source_item_datetime_origin: TWILIGHT timezone UTC+09:00 for source DeleteTime / DateTimes_Korean; source contains no timezone. Expired/unknown contracts remain inactive; equipping never deletes or regrants ownership.
source_equipment_buff_origin: Original raw spell probability base/min/max/multiplier, duration bounds, buff IDs/units/targets/group priority are preserved. Missing native full hit equation uses configurable TWILIGHT baseRaw - targetMR * sourceMultiplier * rawUnit, plus a level delta only when original ByLevel is true. NPC modifier placement/caps and PvP-to-PvE projection are host rules, not a native equation claim. Unsupported effect/qualifier/lifecycle fields block the whole profile.
